overview: Before the rehearsal found its voice, you had the justice's roll in your hand. It was headed Justice. There were eight speeches. The cues were worn through.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the head of the roll and did not invent a cue to fill the holes.

assets.name: the old Knave
assets.disposition: Looked at a part with the cues worn off

summary: Looked at a part with the cues worn off
